rubric: A product is ACCEPTABLE for a query if a shopper who wrote that line on a meal plan would
be satisfied to find it in their cart. Applied as:
1. It must be the food the query names. Sour-cream-flavoured chips are not sour cream.
2. Brand is free when the query names none, and BINDING when it names one.
3. Size, count, packaging and multipack are free unless the query names one.
4. An attribute in the query is binding: "flour" excludes corn, "light" excludes regular.
5. An attribute NOT in the query that changes what the food is, or how it eats, makes the
product unacceptable: light/low-fat, lactose-free, gluten-free, low-carb, whole wheat,
flavoured, dairy-free. Organic is the deliberate exception — it is the same food.
6. Where a call is genuinely debatable, the conservative (unacceptable) reading wins.
See "debatable" below for the calls that could reasonably go the other way.
debatable: Light / low-fat sour cream for an unqualified "sour cream": marked UNACCEPTABLE. Arguable — the meal still works, and the store shelves them together.
Mexican/Salvadoran crema for "sour cream": marked UNACCEPTABLE even where the store title says "Sour Cream". Crema is thinner and saltier.
Organic for an unqualified query: marked ACCEPTABLE. It is the same food, but it costs the shopper more than they asked to spend.
Whole wheat / Carb Balance / Zero Net Carbs tortillas for "tortillas": marked UNACCEPTABLE. They are tortillas, and the meal would work.
Corn tortillas for an unqualified "tortillas": marked ACCEPTABLE. A recipe usually means one or the other, but the query does not say which.
Greek yogurt for "yogurt" (heb|yogurt): marked ACCEPTABLE for the plain whole-milk one. Different texture from regular yogurt.
Case packs ("12 per case") for a single-tub query: marked UNACCEPTABLE.
Lactaid sour cream: marked UNACCEPTABLE as a dietary variant, though it is the same food to most shoppers.
Pre-packaged 1 lb / 2 lb coffee bags for "bulk coffee": marked UNACCEPTABLE. Only true sold-by-weight items counted.
"H-E-B Orange Pepper Seasoned Chicken Thigh For Fajitas" and the Spicy variant: marked UNACCEPTABLE as unrequested flavours of the searched product.
